title: Maximum Frequency in Window
statement: Given an array of N integers and a window size K, find the maximum frequency of any single element in any contiguous window of size K.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and K.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the maximum frequency of any element in any window of size K.

examples.explanation: In window [1,2,1], element 1 appears 2 times. That is the maximum.
Every window of size 2 has two 1s.
